What changes because of this?.text: The drone strike killed at least 73 people, creating civilian casualties. Because the strike hit a market, local market activity is disrupted. The disruption of market activity reduces the availability of food for the local population. The incident is likely to heighten tensions between South Sudan and Sudan.

Who is affected?.text: The drone strike killed at least 73 people, directly affecting those individuals. It also disrupted the local market activity, impacting the community that relies on the market for food and supplies. The disruption of the market can reduce food availability for the local population in Abyei. The incident caused civilian casualties and is likely to heighten tensions between South Sudan and Sudan.
